_comment: The village pig. It eats what nobody else will and turns it into meat faster than any other beast, which is why a settlement with a bad harvest still has something to kill in winter. Bred out of the boars in the marsh.
name: pig
label: Pig

_comment: Fowl. Kept for the eggs rather than the bird: little at a time, every other day, and no work to speak of. The one animal a household can keep without a pasture.
name: chicken
label: Fowl
